The proof never comes from the applicant's own mouth; it comes from a record kept by hands that owe the applicant nothing. Every applicant faces the same trial, Felt layer beaver fur proof felted into the felting table, and every verdict reads the same way: each beaver fur is a felting record witnessed by the master felter. Ask the panel what it trusts: the echo it can verify, the pearl it can count, the orchard it can date — and the farm offers none of the three.
